request.initial_prompt: We have no right to be "disconnected"; we must neither err "disconnectedly" nor strike the truth "disconnectedly." Rather with the necessity with which a tree bears its fruit, so do our thoughts, our values, our Yes's and No's and If's and Whether's, grow connected and interrelated, mutual witnesses of one will, one health, one kingdom, one sun--as to whether they are to your taste, these fruits of ours?--But what matters that to the trees? What matters that to us, us the philosophers?
